summary: US and Israel conducted strikes on Iranian targets including Dezful Airport communications and Qeshm Island, while Iran warned the UK that bases used for attacks are legitimate targets. Iran's Foreign Minister attended the SCO meeting in Kyrgyzstan as Tehran faced diplomatic isolation with embassies of Germany, France, Britain, and North Korea evacuated. The US House passed a $95 billion war funding package and a War Powers Resolution to limit military action, while Trump threatened massive attacks on Iran if the Houthis continue firing on Saudi ships.
key_points: US struck a communications facility at Dezful Airport, Iran (coordinates 32.44570, 48.37926) and missile strikes hit Qeshm Island and Bushehr (Source: @shin_persian/8419, @rodast_omiddana/77447, @New_security8200/202897).
Iran's IRGC warned the UK that any base used to launch attacks on Iran is a legitimate target, accusing Britain of involvement in recent US/Israeli strikes (Source: @Faytuks_Network/5621).

The US House passed the Iran War Powers Resolution 214-208 to halt military action, but also approved $95 billion for war with Iran; the Senate rejected the war powers resolution 49-47 (Source: @presstv/200079, @mamlekate/103975, @rodast_omiddana/77461).

Iran's Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi traveled to Cholpon-Ata, Kyrgyzstan for the SCO Foreign Ministers' Meeting, and met with Iraq's PM Al-Zaidi in Tehran (Source: @presstv/200088, @presstv/200083).
Greece approved a ~3.5 billion euro arms deal with Israel including multi-layered air defense with Rafael's Iron Dome and IAI's Barak systems (Source: @asafroz/51827).
Israel's PM Netanyahu will hold a limited security cabinet meeting on Friday afternoon (Source: @New_security8200/202893).
Two Jews were stabbed and two Arabs shot dead during clashes at Abraham's Vineyard; IDF is investigating (Source: @lelotsenzura/93836).
Iranian state media reported explosions in Konarak, Sistan-Baluchestan and the sound of fighter jets; first US attacks in the past 24 hours (Source: @VahidOnline/77427).

sections.executive_summary: US and Israel struck Iranian targets including Dezful Airport and Qeshm Island as Tehran faced diplomatic isolation with Western embassies evacuated. The US House passed a $95 billion war funding package while narrowly rejecting a War Powers Resolution, and Trump threatened massive retaliation if the Houthis attack Saudi ships. Iran's Foreign Minister attended the SCO summit in Kyrgyzstan and met Iraq's PM in Tehran amid warnings of imminent Israeli attack.
iran: US struck a communications facility at Dezful Airport, Iran at coordinates 32.44570, 48.37926 (Source: @shin_persian/8419). Explosions were heard in Konarak, Sistan-Baluchestan and the sound of fighter jets was reported; these were described as the first US attacks in the past 24 hours (Source: @VahidOnline/77427).

Iran's Judiciary Chief Gholam-Hossein Mohseni Eje'i met with Iraq's Prime Minister Ali Al-Zaidi in Tehran (Source: @presstv/200083). Iran's Foreign Minister left Tehran for Cholpon-Ata, Kyrgyzstan to attend the SCO Foreign Ministers' Meeting (Source: @presstv/200088).

Iran's IRGC warned the UK that any base used to launch attacks on Iran is a legitimate target, accusing Britain of a historic role in regional conflicts and involvement in recent US/Israeli strikes (Source: @Faytuks_Network/5621).
Iran's Supreme Leader's representative called for revenge citing a Quranic verse, stating blood must be repaid with the blood of the killers of the Supreme Leader (Source: @lelotsenzura/93838).

Iranian state media reported explosions in Bushehr and Qeshm Island (Source: @New_security8200/202897). Iran's Foreign Minister Araghchi suggested Iraq's PM Al-Zaidi may be conveying US messages but noted the problem is with US 'approach' not message delivery (Source: @asafroz/51825).
Iran reportedly sent gold on a plane to fund Houthi operations and one IRGC commander traveled to support Houthis with training on new missile systems (Source: @asafroz/51835).
Iranian sources report citizens are hoarding food as war approaches (Source: @kianmeli1/89983).
israel: IDF spokesperson confirmed a stabbing report in the Alon Morah settlement area in Samaria; details were under review (Source: @almogboker78/17780).
IDF forces were deployed to the Jordanian border following concerns of a security incident (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/380279).
Israel's PM Netanyahu will hold a limited security cabinet meeting on Friday afternoon (Source: @New_security8200/202893).

Israel's Defense Minister Yoav Gallant announced Athens approved a comprehensive ~3.5 billion euro arms purchase including Rafael's Iron Dome and IAI's Barak multi-layered air defense systems (Source: @asafroz/51827).

Israel's PM's Office stated that joint US-Israel military action against the 'murderous regime' in Tehran, alongside Israel's dismantling of Iran's terror axis, created an opportunity to expand the circle of peace (Source: @yediotnews25/133109).
Trump confirmed Israel will join a massive attack on Iran if requested (Source: @New_security8200/202892).
A soldier from the Caracal Battalion was injured in a stabbing attack in the Shomron region (Source: @amitsegal/63298).

sections.threat_assessment: The operational tempo is sharply escalating with US strikes on Iranian soil (Dezful, Qeshm, Bushehr) and Iranian retaliatory warnings against the UK and Israel. Iran's diplomatic isolation deepened as Western embassies evacuated Tehran, while the IRGC explicitly threatened UK forces. The Houthi firing on Saudi ships raises the risk of a broader US-Iran confrontation, with Trump threatening to destroy Iranian infrastructure. The $95 billion war funding package signals sustained US military commitment. Iran's proxy network (Houthis, Iraqi militias) is actively engaged, and Iraqi PM Al-Zaidi's Tehran visit suggests Baghdad is attempting to mediate between Washington and Tehran.
sections.regional_response: Regional actors are aligning along conflict lines: Greece approved a major Israeli arms deal ($3.5B) for multi-layered air defense, signaling Gulf and European support for Israeli security. Iraq's PM Al-Zaidi visited Tehran and met Iran's Judiciary Chief, positioning Baghdad as a potential mediator while also receiving US messages. Saudi Arabia's nuclear deal with the US is conditioned on joining the Abraham Accords, linking regional normalization to the Iran conflict. The Houthis continue operating as Iran's proxy, firing on Saudi ships and receiving Iranian training and gold funding.
sections.intelligence_notes: Iranian state media reported the first US attacks in 24 hours in Konarak, Sistan-Baluchestan, alongside explosions in Bushehr and Qeshm Island, suggesting a multi-front strike pattern. Iran's Supreme Leader's representative called for revenge using religious language, indicating potential for asymmetric retaliation. The IDF soldier's video from Gaza supporting Smotrich and calling for settlement rebuilding was referred for military trial, highlighting internal Israeli security concerns. Iran reportedly sent gold via aircraft to fund Houthi operations and deployed an IRGC commander for missile training, indicating sustained logistical support for proxies.
